title: Battery-aware MPC adaptive cruise control for EVs: code, pre-registered tests, results and derived data
description: Python and MATLAB code, pre-registered test rules and reports, result tables and derived 10 Hz lead-vehicle speed windows used in a study of battery-aware model-predictive ACC for battery-electric vehicles. Raw third-party data (OpenACC, BMW i3, Renault Zoe) are not included; see DATA_SOURCES.md. Version 0.2 adds the comparison with real recorded follower cars (normal car vs our design car), safe reinforcement learning with a safety filter, input-feature importance and learning-curve tables, a controller datasheet, and the regen-efficiency 0.65 re-runs.
